# crosswork_survey_settings (Resource)

This resource can manage the customer satisfaction survey setting of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_survey_settings" "example" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the customer satisfaction survey
  - Default value: `true`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_survey_settings.example "survey_settings"
```
